title: Coordinate projection decomposition
statement: Let $[?]$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $[?]$, and let a finite nonempty index set label an orthonormal basis of real functions on that set containing the constant-one function. For a positive integer $n$, equip functions on $[?]^n$ with the product probability inner product; for each coordinate $i$, let $P_i f$ be the average of $f$ over that coordinate with all other coordinates fixed, and set $L_i f=f-P_i f$. Then for all such functions $f,g$, $[?](f,g)=[?](P_i f,P_i g)+[?](L_i f,L_i g)$.
